# Move To is accepted once and the assigned Asset reports its outcome

## 1. Enroll a Move To capable Asset

SDK `GET /dataset` with <enrollment key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

SDK `POST /entities` with <enrollment key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<asset>",
  "request_id": "<asset request>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "credential": "<asset credential>",
  "alias": "Scout One",
  "subtype": "ground vehicle",
  "components": {
    "telemetry": {
      "latitude": 42.2743,
      "longitude": -71.8081
    },
    "health": {
      "battery_percent": 75
    }
  },
  "command_manifest": [
    {
      "command_id": "move_to",
      "scheduling": [
        "queued"
      ],
      "cancellation": true,
      "progress": true
    }
  ]
}
```

→ **201**
```json
{
  "asset": {
    "alias": "Scout One",
    "change_sequence": 1,

      {
        "cancellation": true,
```

## 4. Issue Move To while the Asset has no contact

SDK `POST /tasks` with <operator key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "submission_id": "<Move To submission>",
  "asset_id": "<asset>",
  "command_id": "move_to",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 42.2743,
    "longitude": -71.8081
  },
  "scheduling": "queued"
}
```

→ **201**
```json
{
  "acceptance_sequence": 1,
  "asset_id": "<asset>",
  "change_sequence": 2,
  "command_id": "move_to",
  "created_sequence": 2,
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<Move To task>",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 42.2743,
    "longitude": -71.8081
  },
  "scheduling": "queued",
  "status": "pending",
  "submission_id": "<Move To submission>",
  "version": 1
}
```
